name: hyperos_debloat
description: Audit, inspect, and safely debloat Xiaomi HyperOS and MIUI devices over ADB. Uses AppOps background freeze fallback for Android 14+ protected system packages and safeguards biometric drivers.

action.description: Action to perform on the connected device.

source.description: Package database to consult: 'uad' for UAD-NG recommended list, 'preset' for curated list, or 'all' for both.

package.description: Target package name for audit-apk action (for example: 'com.xiaomi.joyose').
